title: Fonts
description: Each array of fonts creates a priority-based order. The first font in the array should be the ideal font, followed by sensible, web-safe fallbacks

items.name: Display
items.description: Space Grotesk -- geometric, technical, distinctive at large sizes. Used for the wordmark, H1-H3, hero lines, and stat/track-record numbers. Deliberately not a sci-fi/mono display face (e.g. Orbitron) -- those read as costume-y rather than credible to the Brig-Gen/VC/journalist audience.

items.name: Base
items.description: Inter -- high legibility at small sizes, neutral and professional, holds up in dense body copy (Services, Blog) as well as UI chrome (nav, form labels).

items.name: Mono
items.description: JetBrains Mono -- for code blocks, CTF/technical excerpts, and track-record stat labels where a monospace treatment signals 'measured data' rather than marketing copy.
